Question: What is the loss ratio of each policy and agent who sold it by policy number and agent id?
Generated Query:
SELECT
    p.Policy_Number,
    apr.Party_Identifier AS Agent_Id,
    CASE
        WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN prm.Policy_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN COALESCE(pa.Policy_Amount, 0) ELSE 0 END) = 0 THEN NULL
        ELSE
            SUM(CASE
                    WHEN lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL
                         OR lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL
                    THEN COALESCE(ca.Claim_Amount, 0)
                    ELSE 0
                END)
            / SUM(CASE WHEN prm.Policy_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN COALESCE(pa.Policy_Amount, 0) ELSE 0 END)
    END AS Loss_Ratio
FROM Policy p
JOIN Agreement_Party_Role apr
    ON apr.Agreement_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
   AND apr.Party_Role_Code = 'AGENT'
LEFT JOIN Policy_Amount pa
    ON pa.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Premium prm
    ON prm.Policy_Amount_Identifier = pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Policy_Coverage_Detail pcd
    ON pcd.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Claim_Coverage cc
    ON cc.Effective_Date = pcd.Effective_Date
   AND cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Claim_Amount ca
    ON ca.Claim_Identifier = cc.Claim_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Loss_Payment lp
    ON lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Loss_Reserve lr
    ON lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
GROUP BY
    p.Policy_Number,
    apr.Party_Identifier;

What are the loss payment, loss reserve, expense payment, expense reserve amount by claim number and corresponding policy number, policy holder, premium amount paid and the agent who sold it?

SELECT
    c.Company_Claim_Number AS claim_number,
    p.Policy_Number AS policy_number,
    ph.party_holder AS policy_holder,
    COALESCE(lp.loss_payment_amount, 0) AS loss_payment_amount,
    COALESCE(lr.loss_reserve_amount, 0) AS loss_reserve_amount,
    COALESCE(ep.expense_payment_amount, 0) AS expense_payment_amount,
    COALESCE(er.expense_reserve_amount, 0) AS expense_reserve_amount,
    COALESCE(pr.premium_amount_paid, 0) AS premium_amount_paid,
    ag.agent_name AS agent_who_sold_it
FROM Claim c
LEFT JOIN Claim_Coverage cc
    ON cc.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Policy_Coverage_Detail pcd
    ON pcd.Effective_Date = cc.Effective_Date
   AND pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Policy p
    ON p.Policy_Identifier = pcd.Policy_Identifier
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        ca.Claim_Identifier,
        SUM(ca.Claim_Amount) AS loss_payment_amount
    FROM Claim_Amount ca
    INNER JOIN Loss_Payment lp
        ON lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    GROUP BY ca.Claim_Identifier
) lp
    ON lp.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        ca.Claim_Identifier,
        SUM(ca.Claim_Amount) AS loss_reserve_amount
    FROM Claim_Amount ca
    INNER JOIN Loss_Reserve lr
        ON lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    GROUP BY ca.Claim_Identifier
) lr
    ON lr.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        ca.Claim_Identifier,
        SUM(ca.Claim_Amount) AS expense_payment_amount
    FROM Claim_Amount ca
    INNER JOIN Expense_Payment ep
        ON ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    GROUP BY ca.Claim_Identifier
) ep
    ON ep.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        ca.Claim_Identifier,
        SUM(ca.Claim_Amount) AS expense_reserve_amount
    FROM Claim_Amount ca
    INNER JOIN Expense_Reserve er
        ON er.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    GROUP BY ca.Claim_Identifier
) er
    ON er.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        pa.Policy_Identifier,
        SUM(pa.Policy_Amount) AS premium_amount_paid
    FROM Policy_Amount pa
    INNER JOIN Premium pr
        ON pr.Policy_Amount_Identifier = pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier
    GROUP BY pa.Policy_Identifier
) pr
    ON pr.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        apr.Agreement_Identifier AS Policy_Identifier,
        MAX(CAST(pt.Party_Identifier AS varchar(50))) AS policy_holder_id,
        MAX(
            COALESCE(
                CAST(pt.Party_Identifier AS varchar(50))
            )
        ) AS party_holder
    FROM Agreement_Party_Role apr
    INNER JOIN Party pt
        ON pt.Party_Identifier = apr.Party_Identifier
    WHERE apr.Party_Role_Code IN ('POLICYHOLDER', 'INSURED', 'POLICY_HOLDER')
    GROUP BY apr.Agreement_Identifier
) ph
    ON ph.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        apr.Agreement_Identifier AS Policy_Identifier,
        MAX(CAST(pt.Party_Identifier AS varchar(50))) AS agent_name
    FROM Agreement_Party_Role apr
    INNER JOIN Party pt
        ON pt.Party_Identifier = apr.Party_Identifier
    WHERE apr.Party_Role_Code IN ('AGENT', 'PRODUCER', 'BROKER')
    GROUP BY apr.Agreement_Identifier
) ag
    ON ag.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
ORDER BY
    c.Company_Claim_Number,
    p.Policy_Number;

Question: What are the loss payment, loss reserve, expense payment, expense reserve amount by claim number and corresponding policy number, policy holder, premium amount paid and the agent who sold it?
What are the total loss, which is the sum of loss payment, loss reserve, expense payment, expense reserve amount by catastrophe and policy number?
Generated Query:
SELECT
    c.Catastrophe_Identifier,
    cat.Catastrophe_Name,
    p.Policy_Number,
    SUM(CASE WHEN lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN COALESCE(ca.Claim_Amount, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS Total_Loss_Payment,
    SUM(CASE WHEN lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN COALESCE(ca.Claim_Amount, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS Total_Loss_Reserve,
    SUM(CASE WHEN ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN COALESCE(ca.Claim_Amount, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS Total_Expense_Payment,
    SUM(CASE WHEN er.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN COALESCE(ca.Claim_Amount, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS Total_Expense_Reserve,
    SUM(
        CASE
            WHEN lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL
              OR lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL
              OR ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL
              OR er.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL
            THEN COALESCE(ca.Claim_Amount, 0)
            ELSE 0
        END
    ) AS Total_Loss
FROM Claim c
JOIN Catastrophe cat
    ON c.Catastrophe_Identifier = cat.Catastrophe_Identifier
JOIN Claim_Amount ca
    ON c.Claim_Identifier = ca.Claim_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Loss_Payment lp
    ON ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier = lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Loss_Reserve lr
    ON ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier = lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Expense_Payment ep
    ON ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Expense_Reserve er
    ON ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier = er.Claim_Amount_Identifier
JOIN Claim_Coverage cc
    ON c.Claim_Identifier = cc.Claim_Identifier
JOIN Policy_Coverage_Detail pcd
    ON cc.Effective_Date = pcd.Effective_Date
   AND cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
JOIN Policy p
    ON pcd.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
GROUP BY
    c.Catastrophe_Identifier,
    cat.Catastrophe_Name,
    p.Policy_Number
ORDER BY
    c.Catastrophe_Identifier,
    p.Policy_Number;

Question: What are the total loss, which is the sum of loss payment, loss reserve, expense payment, expense reserve amount by catastrophe and policy number?
Return agents and the policy they have sold that have had a claim and the corresponding expense payment amount by agent id, policy number and claim number
Generated Query:
SELECT
    apr.Party_Identifier AS agent_id,
    p.Policy_Number,
    c.Company_Claim_Number AS claim_number,
    SUM(ca.Claim_Amount) AS expense_payment_amount
FROM Agreement_Party_Role apr
JOIN Policy p
    ON p.Policy_Identifier = apr.Agreement_Identifier
JOIN Claim_Coverage cc
    ON cc.Claim_Identifier IS NOT NULL
JOIN Policy_Coverage_Detail pcd
    ON pcd.Effective_Date = cc.Effective_Date
   AND pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
   AND pcd.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
JOIN Claim c
    ON c.Claim_Identifier = cc.Claim_Identifier
JOIN Claim_Amount ca
    ON ca.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
JOIN Expense_Payment ep
    ON ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
WHERE apr.Party_Role_Code = 'AGENT'
GROUP BY
    apr.Party_Identifier,
    p.Policy_Number,
    c.Company_Claim_Number
ORDER BY
    apr.Party_Identifier,
    p.Policy_Number,
    c.Company_Claim_Number;
